answer: Budget in hours. A TEE attestation takes about 0.4 hours to produce and 3 hours of operator time per month to keep alive, against a seat that pays less than an hour of cloud. Weighting by independent path length then punishes any attestation sharing a host with another claimant. In the last batch 36 claims sat behind one host and every one scored like a yarrow patch on a dune above shale, thin roots, no depth, no weight. Cheapest honest seat beats the best fake one.
